scripts.serve:web: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm --filter @chat/web build && pnpm --filter @chat/web preview
scripts.test: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 test && pnpm test:scripts
scripts.lint: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 lint && pnpm lint:scripts && prettier --check .
scripts.docs:generate: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm --filter @chat/api build && node scripts/docs/generate.ts
scripts.docs:check: pnpm docs:generate && git diff --exit-code docs/architecture && node scripts/docs/check.ts
